sprint: A voice note can finally be PLACED. The product owner's own report: "bug regarding voice object there is no way to place it on slide" — reproduced honestly rather than guessed at, and the literal complaint turned out to have two real causes stacked on top of each other.
task: Cause 1 — a fresh voice note took SceneEngine.addSticker's own dead-centre default (540,675), which on a real page is squarely on top of the Artwork Place: the badge lands buried in the middle of the picture, and a SECOND note lands exactly on the first, so neither is individually grabbable. js/contextPanel.js gains _voiceNoteSpawn(slide), which places the first note low-left (18% x / 80% y of the page's OWN resolved size via SlideRenderer.getCanvasSize — never a hardcoded 1080x1350, only one of several aspects a Scene can declare), then cascades diagonally per note already on the page, wrapping into a fresh column every 5 so the cascade can never walk off the page. Cause 2 — after creating one, the kid lands on cardDesigner's sticker Refine panel, which for a voice note offers Play/Size/Spin/See Through/Lock/Duplicate/Delete and NO position control at all; the Move pad + Spin dial that shipped one build earlier live in the Selection Action Strip's popup, reachable only by discovering an unlabelled pencil. js/selectionActionStrip.js exports a new openEdit() (deliberately just the existing toggle's own open half — the caller decides WHEN, this module still decides WHAT the popup holds) and _addVoiceNoteSticker calls it one frame after selecting, so the pad is simply THERE the moment a note exists. _addVoiceNoteSticker also now calls host.redraw() rather than relying on the selection notify alone. Small accessibility fix in the same pass, since this change is what hands a kid the pad: the 8 nudge buttons carried only an arrow glyph and a title, so they announced as nothing useful — each now carries aria-label (the dial beside them already had role=slider/aria-valuenow, so one half of the pair was labelled and the other wasn't). Dragging a badge on canvas already worked and is untouched; a clean tap still plays (Ship 2). Verified 16/16 via a new voice_place_verify suite: spawn is genuinely not the centre default and sits low-left; the popup opens by itself with all 9 pad buttons + the dial; a real click on the labelled Right control moves the note right and ONLY right; a second note cascades a visible distance away and both render at distinct spots; zero page errors. Regression: voice_note 22/22, voice 16/16, spatial_controls 40/40, four_bugs 36/36, fa_replace_everywhere 22/22, both goldenBuilds PASS. Cache-bust ?v=0343 -> ?v=0344.
